data.content: Implementation plan: add one guarded lease-death recovery path that re-reads the knot and verifies the expected bound lease before moving action -> corresponding queue, clearing the binding, terminating the lease if needed, and failing the open step. Route explicit kno lease terminate and lazy expiry through it. Compensate failed claim activation/binding by restoring the original queue. Keep mismatched active ownership as a hard stop. Update docs/leases.md plus skills/knots.md and skills/knots_e2e.md with fresh-lease reclaim guidance, then add runtime, race-guard, install-artifact, and template tests. Complexity: medium. Main risk is partial event/cache updates; reuse the locked failure-transition machinery and preserve repo-lock then cache-lock ordering.
